history.summary: The ISKCON Asansol branch is dedicated as Sri Sri Jagannath Temple, located at Garui Village on the NH-2 Bye-Pass beside the old toll tax, Kanyapur, Asansol 713341. It is the local centre of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness in the Asansol coal belt, with daily darshan of Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra. Coordinates are locality-level for Garui (approximate - verify). FLAG - opening-hours conflict: the temple's own site lists 4:30 AM-1:00 PM and 4:00-8:30 PM daily, while Justdial and aggregators list 7:00 AM-1:30 PM (Mon-Sat) / 7:00 AM-2:00 PM (Sun) with no evening session - verify.

name: Jagannath Temple
town_description: Asansol is West Bengal's second city and the administrative centre of Paschim Bardhaman district, in the state's western coal belt. A major railway junction and industrial city of coal mines and steel plants, it is nicknamed the 'City of Brotherhood' and anchors a cluster of Shakti, Shiva and other Hindu shrines in its suburbs and nearby towns.

travel.airport: Kazi Nazrul Islam Airport (Andal/Durgapur), ~40-50 km - verify.
travel.road: On the NH-2 Bye-Pass at Garui, beside the old toll tax; reachable by taxi/auto-rickshaw from Asansol.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March - pleasant winter weather in the region.
